## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Dōnglái Lǚ tàishǐ Chūnqiū Zuǒzhuàn lèi biān* 東萊呂太史春秋左傳類編 in six juan is the *Zuǒzhuàn* topical reorganisation of Lǚ Zǔqiān [呂祖謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%82%E7%A5%96%E8%AC%99) (1137–1181). It is the work whose existence the SKQS *tíyào* on [KR1e0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0039) notes (Lǚ "had three works on the *Zuǒzhuàn*: the *Lèi biān* dividing the text into nineteen categories, *the Bó yì* [KR1e0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0041) raising matters and establishing meanings, and the present work [the *Zhuàn shuō*]") and which the *tíyào* says is "long without transmitted exemplar, scattered in the *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn* with little to draw from." The present SBCK edition recovers the work in its 19-category form, here reorganised as 6 juan with categorical headings: *gāng lǐng* 綱領 (overview), Zhōu, Qí, Jìn, Chǔ, Wú-Yuè, *yídí* 夷狄, *fùyōng* 附庸, *zhūhóu zhìdù* 諸侯制度, *fēngsú* 風俗, *lǐ* 禮, *shìzú* 氏族, *guānzhì* 官制, *cáiyòng* 財用, *xíng* 刑, *bīngzhì* 兵制, *dìlǐ* 地理, *chūnqiū qián shì* 春秋前事, *lùn yì* 論議. The Republican-era critical apparatus (*jiào kān jì* 校勘記) is by Hú Wénkǎi 胡文楷.

**Abstract**

The *Lèi biān* takes the entire *Zuǒzhuàn* text and redistributes it under nineteen topical categories — by state (Zhōu, Qí, Jìn, Chǔ, Wú, Yuè, plus the barbarians and the small dependencies) and by institutional theme (rites, lineage, official system, taxation, military, geography, customs, etc.). It is the most ambitious Sòng-period topical reorganisation of the *Zuǒzhuàn* and one of the principal forerunners of the late-imperial *Chūnqiū dàshì biǎo* 春秋大事表 form (Gù Dònggāo, mid-Qīng).

The work was used by Lǚ Zǔqiān as a teaching tool for his disciples at the Míngzhāoshān 明招山 academy and at the *Lìzé shūyuàn* 麗澤書院; the topical organisation made it possible to examine all *Zuǒ*-passages relating to a single institutional or political question simultaneously. The *Lèi biān*'s methodological commitment — to read the *Zuǒzhuàn* as a comprehensive evidentiary witness to early Chinese institutions — is the basis on which Lǚ's other *Zuǒzhuàn* works ([KR1e0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0039), [KR1e0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0040), [KR1e0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0041)) are constructed.

The Republican-era SBCK edition recovers the work via collation of late-Sòng print fragments that the SKQS editors did not have access to. Hú Wénkǎi 胡文楷's *jiào kān jì* documents the principal textual variants.
